name: Nara Meideros
summary: In Stormwind's Park, Nara Meideros guides young seekers in Elune's teachings. As a night elf priestess in the human capital, she offers a familiar spiritual presence to her kin.

sections.title: A Priestess in Stormwind
sections.body: Nara Meideros serves Elune far from Kalimdor, across the Great Sea in Stormwind City. In the Park, night elf druids and priests have tended a green refuge. Nara guides young seekers in devotion to the Moon Goddess. Human priests serve the Holy Light in nearby Cathedral Square, while Nara gives night elves visiting or living in the Eastern Kingdoms a connection to their own faith.

faq.q: Where can I find Nara Meideros?
faq.answer: Find Nara Meideros in the Park district of Stormwind City, among moonwells and towering trees that recall home to night elf travelers.

faq.q: What role does Nara Meideros serve?
faq.answer: Nara trains priests, helping novices and growing priests. She directs human priests to the Cathedral of Light to learn devotional spells such as Desperate Prayer.

faq.q: Why is a night elf priestess residing in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Night elf ties with the Grand Alliance are growing stronger. Emissaries, druids, and priests from Darnassus keep an active presence in the Park to aid their kin and represent their spiritual traditions.

angles.text: As a night elf priest traveling in the Eastern Kingdoms, you can seek Nara's guidance in important racial devotions without returning to Kalimdor.
Far from Ashenvale and Teldrassil, you can find a comforting piece of home with Nara Meideros in the Park, amid Stormwind's stone walls.
